environment.description: Same Actix-web binary deployed on ECS Fargate (0.25 vCPU, 512MB task). An ALB fronts the service with idle timeout set to 5 seconds. The ECS task definition specifies a stopTimeout of 10s. The crucial control: the Cargo.toml pins regex = '1.9.6' which defaults to regex::RegexBuilder size_limit of 10KB (actually the compiled DFA size limit was reduced in this version's default configuration when the 'unicode' feature is disabled, which it is in this build via default-features = false, features = ['std', 'perf']). Additionally, the PostgreSQL 15 connection uses a dedicated 'app_restricted' role with a connection-level statement_timeout = '2s' and the role does NOT have BYPASSRLS. The RLS policy on the documents table is: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')). A pg_hba.conf rule restricts the app_restricted role to connections only from the Fargate subnet CIDR. The ALB has an AWS WAF WebACL attached but it only contains AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet (not the SQLi ruleset) — this is primarily for generic request size limiting (body max 8KB).

config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.pg_hba_restriction: app_restricted role limited to Fargate subnet CIDR
